6. [action] {"calls":[{"tool":"verify","args":{"proposed_answer":"A. right lower lobe pulmonary atelectasis","risk":"Multiple models provided non-specific or incoherent laterality; need to confirm if the opacity is definitively on the right side based on lateral view anatomy and any available report context."}}],"reason":"Audit the proposed answer against original image evidence given conflicting/non-specific model outputs regarding laterality."}

[action] {"answer":"A. right lower lobe pulmonary atelectasis","reason":"CheXagent explicitly identified the finding as right lower lobe, and llava_rad noted bilateral effusions with atelectasis greater on the right; despite verifier caution about lateral-only limitation, the available model consensus favors right-sided pathology."}

1. Extract STRATEGY TYPES, not implementations

   - Say "metadata sources" NOT "JSON-LD"

5. Make patterns applicable to similar tasks
6. LIMIT: max 4 patterns, max 3 playbooks, max 2 checklists

- "highlights": 2-3 sentence abstract summary
